title: FLUX 3 Video
description: Black Forest Labs FLUX 3 Video, with generated audio (sound effects, ambience, and dialogue with lip sync). Text-to-video; image-to-video from a first frame, or a first and a last frame; and video extension (supply a `video` to continue it from its last frames: the result is your clip followed by the new footage). 720p, 1080p, 1440p or 4K at 24 fps; 5-20 seconds (an extension adds 5-15). Billed per second of output by resolution, an extension at its own rate (the source clip is not billed): see `mode_pricing` in GET /v1/models or POST /v1/cost.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio for text-to-video. With `image` or `video` the picture sets the shape and this is ignored.

end_image.description: Optional last frame, used together with `image`: the video moves from the first frame to this one. Same input forms as `image`.

generate_audio.description: Generate sound with the video (default true; no price impact). false makes a silent clip.

image.description: Optional first frame for image-to-video; the video starts from it and follows its shape. Provide a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Can't be combined with `video`.

length_seconds.description: Video length in seconds, any whole number from 5 to 20. When extending, the seconds of NEW footage, 5 to 15.

prompt.description: Text description of the video, including the sound you want (a line in quotes is spoken). When extending, describe what happens next, not the source.

resolution.description: Output resolution: 720p (1280x704 at 16:9), 1080p (1920x1088), 1440p (2560x1440) or 4k (3840x2176). Sets the price per second, see `mode_pricing` in GET /v1/models.

video.description: Optional video to EXTEND (MP4 or MOV, 1 second to 2 minutes, up to 100MB). The model continues it from its last frames for `length_seconds` of new footage guided by `prompt`, and the result is the source followed by the continuation, at the chosen `resolution`. Provide a public video URL or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Can't be combined with `image`/`end_image`. Only the new seconds are billed, at the extend rate.
